prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on what you need (brand vs. performance vs. product marketing), your budget, your industry, and whether you want a small/local shop or a large national firm with a KC office.

A quick, practical approach:
- If you want big-brand, high‑concept creative and a full-service partner: Barkley (based in KC) is one of the best-known local agencies.
- If you need enterprise-level digital transformation and integrated global services: VMLY&R has a major presence and strong digital capabilities.
(Those are examples — they’re highly regarded, but not the only good options.)

How to pick the best fit:
- Define goals and KPIs (brand awareness, leads, sales, app installs, etc.).
- Look for relevant case studies and client references in your industry.
- Check size/culture fit (startup vs. enterprise experience).
- Evaluate measurable results and reporting cadence.
- Compare fees and what’s included (strategy, creative, media buying, analytics).
- Read reviews (Clutch, Google, UpCity) and local award lists (KC Business Journal, Ad Age).

If you want, tell me:
- What type of marketing you need (branding, digital ads, SEO, content, social, PR, etc.)
- Your monthly/annual budget
- Industry and company size
I’ll shortlist 4–6 Kansas City agencies that match your needs, with specialties and pros/cons for each. Which details can you share?
